pin.title: 🔒 Settings PIN
settings.framed: Settings can't be opened while the display is shown inside another page. Open the display's own address instead.
settings.title: ⚙ Display Settings
settings.setupHint: Start here: enter the masjid name and location. Then check the calculation method (Prayer Times) and set your Jumu'ah time (Iqamah & Jumu'ah). Everything else can stay as it is.
settings.sync.registerNote: After approval your masjid also appears in Find your masjid, usually within a few hours.
settings.sync.role.followNote: Follow a masjid's times; the rest is yours
settings.sync.role.manageNote: Change settings here for every screen
settings.sync.about.follow: Prayer times, iqamah, Jumu'ah, Eid and announcements come from the masjid. Everything else on this screen is yours. It keeps working offline on the last copy.
settings.sync.about.masjid: This screen shows everything the masjid sets, and keeps up with every change.
settings.sync.about.manage: Nothing is locked here. Change anything in any tab, then press Apply and publish; you'll be asked for the publish passphrase.
settings.sync.about.manageCloudflare: Nothing is locked here. Change anything in any tab, then press Apply and publish, and sign in to send it to every screen.
settings.sync.about.ownSheet: This masjid's settings are changed in its own Google Sheet, not from a screen.
settings.sync.summary: These settings will be shared with every screen:
settings.sync.summaryHint: To change them, use the Masjid, Prayer Times and Iqamah & Jumu'ah tabs first. Iqamah, Eid and announcements are shared too.
settings.sync.haveCode: Already registered? Use its code and passphrase
settings.sync.manageThis: Type the publish passphrase to manage {name} from this screen.
settings.sync.pendingManage: Waiting for approval. Until then other screens can't follow this masjid; what you publish now reaches them once it's approved.
settings.sync.bannerManage: You manage {name}: Apply and publish sends your changes to every screen.
settings.sync.problem.unknownCode: There's no masjid with that code yet.
settings.sync.pointer: To follow a masjid, set up a masjid screen, or register and manage your masjid:
settings.sync.detail.name: Name
settings.sync.detailsMissing: Set the masjid's name and location in the Masjid tab first.
settings.sync.passphraseHint: At least 12 characters; three or four unrelated words work well (not the masjid's name or city). Every admin needs it to publish changes, and no one can look it up or reset it, so keep it somewhere safe.
settings.sync.authorised: I'm authorised to manage this masjid's screens
settings.sync.registering: Registering… this can take up to a minute.
settings.sync.registerAgain: Register again with a new passphrase
settings.sync.registerAgainNote: For a lost passphrase. The masjid keeps its code; the new passphrase works once it's approved again. Until then, screens keep the current settings.
settings.sync.registeredAgain: Sent. Ask for the masjid to be approved again, then publish with the new passphrase.
settings.sync.keyFingerprint: This masjid's publish key starts with {key}. Read it out to whoever approves masjids: they check it in the sheet's Publish key column before ticking Approved.
settings.sync.sending: Publishing… this can take up to a minute.
settings.sync.problem.short: The passphrase needs at least 12 characters.
settings.sync.problem.weak: That passphrase would be easy to guess. Use words that have nothing to do with the masjid: not its name, city or code, and not a short pattern repeated.
settings.sync.problem.authorised: Tick the box to confirm you're authorised by the masjid.
settings.sync.problem.wrong: That isn't this masjid's publish passphrase.
settings.sync.problem.offline: Couldn't reach Google. Check the connection and try again.
settings.sync.problem.setup: Registration isn't set up correctly on this site yet. Let whoever runs it know.
settings.sync.problem.keyFailed: This browser couldn't work out the masjid's key from the passphrase. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
settings.sync.problem.tooBig: These settings are too long to publish. Shorten the announcements and try again.
settings.sync.problem.notConfirmed: Sent, but it hasn't appeared in the masjid's sheet yet. Press Check now in a minute; if nothing has changed, try again.
settings.sync.problem.formRefused: The form didn't accept it, so nothing reached the sheet. Check that the form is published, accepts responses without signing in, collects no email addresses, and has no required questions.
settings.sync.status.noValid: No valid update from the masjid yet; running on the saved settings
settings.sync.status.setup: The registration sheet isn't set up as the guide describes
settings.sync.noMatches: No masjid matches; you can enter its code below.
settings.sync.linkScreen: Link for the masjid's own screens
settings.sync.bannerLocked: Prayer times, iqamah, Jumu'ah, Eid, the location and announcements come from {name} and can't be changed here. Everything else is yours to set.
settings.sync.bannerMasjidScreen: This is a masjid screen: it also uses the masjid's display settings.
settings.sync.badCode: A code is 4–16 letters or digits.
settings.sync.status.pending: New settings are waiting; they apply when Settings closes
settings.sync.status.offline: Offline; running on the saved settings
settings.sync.status.notFound: This code isn't set up yet
settings.sync.status.notShared: Can't read the masjid's sheet; check it's shared “Anyone with the link: Viewer”
settings.sync.status.invalid: The shared settings couldn't be read; nothing was changed
settings.sync.skipped: {n} rows in the sheet were skipped (unknown setting or unreadable value)
settings.sync.publishing: Finish publishing in the new tab…
settings.sync.popupBlocked: The publish tab was blocked; allow pop-ups for this site and try again
settings.import.error: Could not load settings file — invalid format.
settings.import.ok: Settings loaded — click Apply to commit.
settings.eco.note: Softens motion and lowers background intensity to help reduce burn-in and power use.
settings.beep.desc: Plays at adhan and iqamah times for each prayer
settings.beep.adhan.desc: Beep when each prayer time begins
settings.masjidName.placeholder: e.g. Masjid Al-Noor, Islamic Centre of Toronto…
settings.searchCity.placeholder: Type any city name, e.g. Karachi, Lyon, Nairobi…
settings.searchCity.empty: No results found — try a different spelling
settings.highLat.note: Only matters above ~48° latitude in summer, when the sun doesn't dip far enough below the horizon for standard Fajr/Isha angles.
settings.size.note: Adjusts text size only — layout stays put. Useful for TVs at distance.
settings.region.none: No usual method on file for {place} — check the method against your mosque's timetable.
settings.iqamahAuto.note: Sets each iqamah from the day's adhan, so the times follow the seasons without editing. Turn it off to enter fixed minutes instead.
settings.iqamahAuto.fajrSunrise: Fajr: hold iqamah until this many minutes before sunrise (0 = off)
settings.iqamahAuto.hint: Shown: today's iqamah. Each prayer waits at least its minutes, then moves up to the rounding step — a quarter-hour keeps the time the same for days. Maghrib waits exactly its minutes. Fajr is never later than 15 minutes before sunrise.
settings.eid.banner: Show banner this many days before Eid
settings.announcements.auto.note: Adds notices for the next prayer and iqamah, Jumu'ah, expected Ramadan and Eid dates, and Sunnah fasts.
settings.announcements.placeholder:
One announcement per line, e.g.
Funeral after Maghrib
Sunday picnic 11 AM
settings.announcements.note: Each line becomes one item in the scrolling ticker at the bottom of the screen. Leave blank to hide the ticker entirely.
settings.announcements.format: Optional per-line tags: start with ! for urgent, and/or @YYYY-MM-DD to auto-expire. Example: ! @2026-12-31 Fundraiser after Isha
settings.blackout.note: Dims the dashboard from a few seconds before iqamah until the prayer ends, so the screen doesn't distract worshippers. Hold anywhere on the dark screen for 3 seconds to dismiss early.
settings.eid.note: Eid banner appears automatically when the Hijri calendar detects an upcoming Eid. Toggle individual slots on/off as needed.
widget.fast.label: Fast
auto.prayerInProgress: Prayer in progress — please silence your phone
auto.friday.sunnah: Friday: read Surah al-Kahf and send abundant salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
auto.eid.expectedIn: {eid} expected in {days} days, subject to moon sighting
auto.eid.expectedTomorrow: {eid} expected tomorrow, subject to moon sighting
auto.eid.greeting: Eid Mubarak! May Allah accept from us and from you
auto.ramadan.expectedIn: Ramadan expected to begin in {days} days, subject to moon sighting
auto.ramadan.expectedTomorrow: Ramadan expected to begin tomorrow, subject to moon sighting
auto.ramadan.lastTen: The last ten nights of Ramadan — seek Laylat al-Qadr in the odd nights
auto.dhulhijjah.ten: The first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah — no good deeds are better than those done in these days (Sahih al-Bukhari)
settings.screenLabel.note: Replaces the "Prayer Times · Digital Display" subtitle. Leave blank for the default.
settings.viewing.calibrate.note: Walk to the farthest spot people pray, then adjust until this is clearly readable.
settings.viewing.note: Scales all text for legibility at distance. Combines with the size slider above.
auto.fast.virtue.arafah: Fasting the Day of Arafah is hoped to expiate the sins of the past and the coming year (Sahih Muslim)
auto.fast.virtue.ashura: Fasting Ashura is hoped to expiate the sins of the past year (Sahih Muslim)
auto.fast.virtue.tasua: Fast the 9th together with the 10th (Sahih Muslim)
